name: cascade-c2-v1
status: pre-registered before any C2 run (pilot or confirmatory). Thresholds and metrics below are fixed.
question: Does a critical threshold exist beyond which an initial forced sale generates secondary liquidations that amplify market losses beyond the primary shock's direct price impact?
valid_outcomes: secondary liquidations without meaningful price amplification
no secondary liquidations in the tested range
data_policy: SYNTHETIC only. No historical evaluation data, no BTC/ETH holdout, no SOL/BNB vault, no LLM calls.

inspection_facts_before_design.liquidation_rule: an account is in breach when equity < maintenance_margin (0.02) x gross notional, evaluated once per 1 s tick on venue mids (kernel/clearing.py needs_liquidation, kernel/exchange.py run_liquidations); the full position is sent as a forced IOC market order on every non-halted venue
inspection_facts_before_design.margin_distance: for a uniform relative price move x: breach when E + N x < mm G (1+x), N = net notional, G = gross notional; x* = (mm G - E)/(N - mm G); distance = |x*|
inspection_facts_before_design.leverage_use: leveraged policy target = signal x min(equity, 2 x initial capital) x max_leverage (20) x leverage_use; |signal| < 0.25 -> flat; per-agent values are the centre jittered +/-30% and clipped to [0.1, 1.0], so centre 1.0 gives [0.7, 1.0] and centre 0.7 gives [0.49, 0.91]
inspection_facts_before_design.stop_loss: leveraged agents also run a stop-loss at stop_bps (centre 150 bps, jittered) checked only when they wake; it can close a position before maintenance margin is reached
inspection_facts_before_design.size_scale_defect: C2 varies leverage through param_overrides.leveraged.leverage_use, never size_scale; size_scale['leveraged'] now raises (v0.4 fix)
inspection_facts_before_design.primary_shock: whale_liquidation: an external account builds a long of the given size from 60 s to (shock - 120 s) in alternating-venue chunks, then its collateral is withdrawn to 1% of gross and the engine force-liquidates it on the next tick

design.population: default 256 agents (16 leveraged), defaults unchanged except leverage_use centre

arms.B: secondary forced-liquidation execution suppressed (execute_secondary_liquidations = false); breaches are still computed and recorded; the external whale is always liquidated. Deliberately nonphysical counterfactual.

pilot.role: EXPLORATORY feasibility only (runtime, whale build-up reaches its size, halts). Its results are not used for any confirmatory statistic and may only motivate a documented feasibility amendment before the confirmatory runs.

design.pairing: for each (size, leverage_use, seed) arms A and B share the identical config except the switch; trajectories must be identical until the first secondary breach (checked from per-second trade hashes)

per_run: pre-shock 10-level depth (median, venue 0) and near-mid depth within 20 bps; minimum 10-level depth in the shock window
direct impact of the primary liquidation: venue-average mid at the primary liquidation tick vs the last pre-shock tick
primary forced notional and closed lots; whale position reached vs requested

margin breaches (transition into breach) of agent accounts, executed or not; executed secondary liquidations, their forced notional; time from primary liquidation to first secondary breach and first secondary liquidation
margin distance distribution of all agent accounts with positions at the last pre-shock tick (min, quantiles, leveraged only)
maximum adverse move: min venue-average mid in the shock window vs pre-shock
mid at +10 s, +60 s, +300 s after the primary liquidation
1-minute volatility and median spread in the shock window vs pre window
half-recovery time: first time after the trough at which the mid regains 50% of the drop (censored at 1800 s)
propagation: breaches and secondary liquidations per 10 s bin in the shock window; generation of each breach (1 + generation of the most recent forced execution strictly before it; primary = 0)
voluntary deleveraging (exploratory): leveraged stop-loss exits and noise panic sales in the shock window

causal_definitions.breach_vs_liquidation: a breach is the margin condition; a liquidation is an executed forced order. Arm B has breaches without secondary liquidations.
causal_definitions.primary_vs_secondary: primary = forced liquidation of the external whale account; secondary = forced liquidation of any of the 256 agents
causal_definitions.incremental_drop: paired (A - B) difference of the maximum adverse move; negative = deeper in A
causal_definitions.induced_breach: an agent breached in arm A during the shock window that is not breached in arm B of the same seed during the shock window
causal_definitions.chain_observed_in_seed: arm A has at least one secondary liquidation followed (strictly later) by an induced breach

H1-cascade.claim: some grid configuration produces a liquidation feedback cascade
H1-cascade.supported_if: for that configuration ALL hold: (a) secondary liquidations in >= 2 of 8 seeds; (b) incremental drop t-interval (n = 8) entirely below 0; (c) mean incremental drop >= 10% of the mean arm-B drop magnitude; (d) chain observed in >= 2 of 8 seeds
H1-cascade.null_H0: for every configuration at least one of (a)-(d) fails: observed losses are the direct mechanical consequence of the whale's forced sale

H2-onset.claim: the onset of secondary liquidations is monotone in whale size at fixed leverage_use
H2-onset.report: per configuration the fraction of seeds with >= 1 secondary liquidation (Wilson 95% CI); onset bracket = (largest size with 0/8, smallest size with >= 2/8). If no configuration reaches 2/8: 'threshold not observed within the tested range'.

H3-shape.claim: if an onset exists, the incremental drop jumps rather than growing proportionally
H3-shape.report: 'transition-like' only if incremental drop is negligible (t-interval includes 0 AND |mean| < 10% of arm-B drop) at the lower bracket and meets H1 (b)+(c) at the upper; otherwise 'graded'. With 3 sizes the sharpness of a transition cannot be estimated; no threshold curve is fitted.

classification_rule: no_secondary_liquidations if (a) fails; secondary_without_amplification if (a) holds and (b) or (c) fails; amplification_without_chain if (a)-(c) hold and (d) fails; cascade only if (a)-(d) hold
statistics: unit of replication = seed (never individual events within a run); paired differences over 8 seeds with bootstrap and t-intervals; Wilson intervals for seed fractions
stopping_rule: one confirmatory run per (configuration, arm, seed). Any further sizes/leverage/seeds are a new exploratory protocol version and cannot confirm H1 on these seeds.

amendment_1.before: written before the pilot and before any confirmatory run; motivated only by a code smoke test (seed 1, 700 s) and an inspection run (seed 901, 2000 BTC, lu 1.0, 1500 s, NOT part of the protocol's statistics)
amendment_1.finding: the primary forced sale is not a single sweep: the external account stays in liquidation and sells ~20-40 BTC per tick for 30 s or more as the book refills; the whale also reaches less than the requested size because its build-up market orders are partly unfilled (1514 of 2000 BTC in the inspection run)
amendment_1.change: ADD descriptive measurements only: primary selling duration, BTC sold, mid at the end of primary selling, primary BTC per 10 s; and report the whale's reached position next to the nominal size. 'direct_impact' (first tick) stays as registered but is NOT the causal baseline: the causal baseline for the primary shock is arm B, which contains the full primary process. Hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules are unchanged.

amendment_2.before: after the exploratory pilot (seed 900, artifacts/observatory/cascade_c2_pilot.json), before any confirmatory run
pilot_feasibility_findings: whale build-up saturates: nominal 2000 and 4000 BTC reach only ~1745-1825 BTC (market-buy chunks partly unfilled, 0 rejections); the dose axis is effectively {1000, ~1750, ~1800} BTC
all 16 leveraged agents were SHORT at the shock (margin distance 'up', 2.9-4.8%, effective leverage 14-20x) in all 6 pilot configurations
amendment_2.change: NONE to design, hypotheses, thresholds or seeds. The threshold analysis additionally reports the reached whale position per configuration; conclusions about 'size' refer to the reached position. The pilot is not used in any confirmatory statistic.
amendment_2.exploratory_followup_declared_now: if the confirmatory result is null and leveraged agents are short at the shock, a separately versioned EXPLORATORY protocol (cascade_c2x) may test the positioning explanation with a mirrored shock (forced BUY by a short whale). It cannot confirm H1 of this protocol.
